}}The '''2024 Chilean Population and Housing Census''' ({{Langx|es|Censo Chileno de Población y Vivienda 2024}}), officially the '''XX National Population Census and IX Housing Census''' ({{Langx|es|XX Censo Nacional de Población y IX de Vivienda}}), was organized by the [[National Statistics Institute (Chile)|National Statistics Institute]] and took place between 9 March and 31 July 2024.

==Background==

===2012 census===
The 2024 census was the third in 15 years. The first of them, the [[2012 Chilean census|2012 census]] was executed in a {{Interlanguage link|De jure census|lt="de jure"|es|Censo de Derecho}} methodology, meaning the number of people in the country was registered into the census based on people's usual residence, even if they were not present there at the time.<ref name=":0">{{Cite news |date=2020-03-04 |title=Gobierno define plan para Censo 2022: será de derecho y se extenderá por tres meses  - La Tercera |url=https://www.latercera.com/pulso/noticia/gobierno-define-plan-para-censo-2022-sera-de-derecho-y-se-extendera-por-tres-meses/XZ45IGC2PBEMZP5BERLCKHYSQE/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305003603/https://www.latercera.com/pulso/noticia/gobierno-define-plan-para-censo-2022-sera-de-derecho-y-se-extendera-por-tres-meses/XZ45IGC2PBEMZP5BERLCKHYSQE/ |archive-date=2020-03-05 |access-date=2026-04-18 |work=La Tercera |language=es-CL}}</ref> This method was criticized due to its inaccuracy, omitting an estimated 10% of the total population, with some [[Communes of Chile|communes]] reporting a 20% omission rate.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web |date=2013-08-09 |title=El fracaso del "mejor censo en la historia de Chile" |url=https://www.bbc.com/mundo/noticias/2013/08/130809_chile_problemas_del_censo_2012_ng |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=BBC News Mundo |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Bezama |first=Boris |date=2013-08-08 |title=CENSO 2012: Comisión de expertos ratificó errores y recomendó rehacerlo el 2015 |url=https://www.ciperchile.cl/2013/08/07/censo-2012-comision-de-expertos-ratifico-errores-y-recomendo-rehacerlo-el-2015/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=CIPER Chile |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2014-09-23 |title=Los cinco fallos del Censo 2012 que inhabilitaron el uso de sus datos |url=https://www.t13.cl/noticia/actualidad/los-cinco-fallos-del-censo-2012-que-inhabilitaron-el-uso-de-sus-datos |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=T13 |language=es}}</ref>

===2017 Census===
The [[2017 Chilean census|April 2017 census]], which used a "de facto" methodology, recorded an increase in the population between 2012 and 2017, with the official population standing at {{val|17574003}} people.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web |title=WEB DISEMINACIÓN CENSO 2017 WEB DISEMINACIÓN CENSO 2017 |url=http://resultados.censo2017.cl/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=resultados.censo2017.cl}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Resultados |url=https://censo2024.ine.gob.cl/resultados/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Censo 2024 |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Primeros Resultados Definitivos del Censo 2017: Un Total de 17.574.003 Personas Fueron Efectivamente Censadas |website=Servicio Nacional del Adulto Mayor |url=http://www.senama.gob.cl/noticias/primeros-resultados-definitivos-del-censo-2017-un-total-de-17574003-personas-fueron-efectivamente-ce |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220618150646/http://www.senama.gob.cl/noticias/primeros-resultados-definitivos-del-censo-2017-un-total-de-17574003-personas-fueron-efectivamente-ce |archive-date=2022-06-18 |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=es}}</ref>

==Census==

===Delays===
The census was originally set to take in April 2022.<ref name=":2">{{Cite web |title=INE posterga en un año la realización del Censo de 2022 |url=https://www.cooperativa.cl/noticias/pais/poblacion/censos/ine-posterga-en-un-ano-la-realizacion-del-censo-de-2022/2020-10-02/123059.html |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Cooperativa.cl |language=es}}</ref> However, the [[National Statistics Institute (Chile)|National Statistics Institute]] announced a delay in October 2020 due to sanitary restrictions imposed during the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Chile|COVID-19 pandemic]], delaying it to March 2023.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2020-10-02 |title=Pandemia obliga al INE a postergar Censo 2022 en un año - La Tercera |url=https://www.latercera.com/pulso/noticia/pandemia-obliga-al-ine-a-postergar-censo-2022-en-un-ano/JXHBLPDWEJGO7IQM66HX5NJN2Y/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201030103152/https://www.latercera.com/pulso/noticia/pandemia-obliga-al-ine-a-postergar-censo-2022-en-un-ano/JXHBLPDWEJGO7IQM66HX5NJN2Y/ |archive-date=2020-10-30 |access-date=2026-04-18 |work=La Tercera |language=es-CL}}</ref><ref name=":2" /><ref>{{Cite news |title=La postergación del Censo 2022 y el costo de un Censo 2012 fallido |url=https://www.eldinamo.cl/opinion/2020/10/10/la-postergacion-del-censo-2022-y-el-costo-de-un-censo-2012-fallido/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |newspaper=El Dínamo |language=es}}</ref> In 2022, the census was delayed a second time, due to logistical and planning problems, with the new census set to take place between March and July 2024.<ref>{{Cite news |date=2022-05-24 |title=Gobierno posterga por segunda vez el Censo y ahora quedará para marzo-junio de 2024 - La Tercera |url=https://www.latercera.com/pulso/noticia/gobierno-anuncia-postergacion-del-censo-de-poblacion-y-vivienda-para-marzo-junio-de-2024/YQEEFCM6YRHPTECR5KFITZ4JU4/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220524231424/https://www.latercera.com/pulso/noticia/gobierno-anuncia-postergacion-del-censo-de-poblacion-y-vivienda-para-marzo-junio-de-2024/YQEEFCM6YRHPTECR5KFITZ4JU4/ |archive-date=2022-05-24 |access-date=2026-04-18 |work=La Tercera |language=es-CL}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Reyes |first=Felipe |date=2022-05-24 |title=Gobierno posterga por segunda vez el Censo: conoce la nueva fecha en que se realizará el proceso |url=https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/nacional/chile/2022/05/24/gobierno-anuncia-segunda-postergacion-del-censo-se-realizara-entre-marzo-y-junio-de-2024.shtml |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=BioBioChile - La Red de Prensa Más Grande de Chile |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-05-24 |title=Ministerio de Economía e INE confirmaron postergación de Censo para marzo-junio de 2024 |url=https://www.soychile.cl/Santiago/Sociedad/2022/05/24/758821/censo-suspendido.html |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=SoyChile |language=es}}</ref>

===Methodology===
For the 2024 census, the Chilean government decided to use the "de jure" methodology again.<ref name=":0" /> The census consisted of a 50 question [[questionnaire]], which was in both a physical and digital format to allow for a broader coverage.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Censo en Línea: la modalidad complementaria para que nadie quede sin ser censado |url=http://www.ine.gob.cl/sala-de-prensa/prensa/general/noticia/2024/03/18/censo-en-l%C3%ADnea-la-modalidad-complementaria-para-que-nadie-quede-sin-ser-censado |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Default}}</ref> Nearly {{val|25000}} people carried out the census between 2 phases.<ref>{{Cite news |newspaper=El Mercurio |date=2024-02-15 |title=Casi 25 mil censistas se desplegarán por el país: El 84% se concentra en ocho regiones y Aysén será la con menor personal |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/Economia/2024/02/15/1121845/25-mil-censistas-regiones.html |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=es}}</ref> The first, which took place between March 9 and June 2, censed 179 of the 346 communes.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Según lo planificado, el domingo 2 de junio Censo finaliza visitas a viviendas en las primeras 179 comunas del país |url=http://www.ine.gob.cl/sala-de-prensa/prensa/general/noticia/2024/05/31/seg%C3%BAn-lo-planificado-el-domingo-2-de-junio-censo-finaliza-visitas-a-viviendas-en-las-primeras-179-comunas-del-pa%C3%ADs |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Default}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=2024-02-20 |title=CENSO 2024: Se iniciará el sábado 9 de marzo y durará hasta el mes de junio |url=https://www.labatalla.cl/censo-2024-se-iniciara-el-sabado-9-de-marzo-y-durara-hasta-el-mes-de-junio/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |newspaper=Diario La Batalla de Maipú |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |newspaper=El Mercurio |date=2024-02-15 |title=Censo 2024 tiene fecha: Comenzará el 9 de marzo y se extenderá durante tres meses |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/Economia/2024/02/15/1121822/cuanto-empieza-censo-2024.html |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=es}}</ref> The second phase started in early May, with the objective of censing the remaining 1.7% of the country which could not be censed in the first phase.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-05-07 |title=Se inicia la segunda etapa del Censo 2024, habiendo ya visitado más de 6 millones de viviendas |url=https://censo2024.ine.gob.cl/se-inicia-la-segunda-etapa-del-censo-2024-habiendo-ya-visitado-mas-de-6-millones-de-viviendas/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Gobierno de Chile |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |title=Censo inicia su segunda etapa que durará hasta junio |newspaper=Diario Financiero |url=https://www.df.cl/economia-y-politica/pais/censo-inicia-su-segunda-etapa-que-durara-hasta-junio |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=es-CL}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-12 |title=¿En qué consiste la fase final del Censo de Población y Vivienda 2024? - Universidad de Chile |url=https://uchile.cl/noticias/217297/en-que-consiste-la-fase-final-del-censo-de-poblacion-y-vivienda-2024 |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=uchile.cl |language=es}}</ref> The census ended on 31 July 2024 after nearly 5 months.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Díaz |first=Joaquín |date=2024-07-27 |title=Cuándo termina el Censo y qué hacer si no fuiste encuestado |url=https://www.latercera.com/nacional/noticia/cuando-termina-el-censo-y-que-hacer-si-no-fuiste-encuestado/6KCIEBCAWZBEBMS6XTLPGU4LQA/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=La Tercera |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=INE informa que este 31 de julio finaliza el Censo 2024, quedando solo 10 días para su cierre |url=http://www.ine.gob.cl/sala-de-prensa/prensa/general/noticia/2024/07/22/ine-informa-que-este-31-de-julio-finaliza-el-censo-2024-quedando-solo-10-d%C3%ADas-para-su-cierre |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Default}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-07-31 |title=Este 31 de julio finaliza el Censo 2024 |url=https://censo2024.ine.gob.cl/este-31-de-julio-finaliza-el-censo-2024/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Gobierno de Chile |language=es}}</ref>

==Results==
The National Statistics Institute published the results of the census in late March 2025.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web |title=Primeros resultados del Censo 2024: 18.480.432 personas fueron censadas en Chile, manteniéndose la tendencia de envejecimiento de la población |url=http://www.ine.gob.cl/sala-de-prensa/prensa/general/noticia/2025/03/27/primeros-resultados-del-censo-2024-18.480.432-personas-fueron-censadas-en-chile-manteni%C3%A9ndose-la-tendencia-de-envejecimiento-de-la-poblaci%C3%B3n |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Default}}</ref> The total population censed was {{val|18480432}}, a 5.16% increase since the 2017 census.<ref name=":3" /><ref name=":4">{{Cite web |title=Censo 2024: Un total de 18.480.432 personas fueron censadas en Chile |url=https://www.gob.cl/noticias/censo-2024-total-18480432-personas-fueron-censadas-chile/ |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=Gobierno de Chile |language=es}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Díaz |first=Nicolás |date=2025-03-28 |title=Revisa aquí cuántas personas fueron censadas en tu comuna en 2024 |url=https://www.biobiochile.cl/noticias/servicios/toma-nota/2025/03/28/revisa-aqui-cuantas-personas-viven-en-tu-comuna-segun-el-censo-2024.shtml |access-date=2026-04-18 |website=BioBioChile - La Red de Prensa Más Grande de Chile |language=es}}</ref> The region with the highest population was the [[Santiago Metropolitan Region|Santiago Metropolitan region]], with {{val|7400741}} people, while the region with the lowest population was [[Aysén Region|Aysén region]], with {{val|100745}} people, the only region to experience a (small) loss in population between 2017 and 2024, while the [[Magallanes Region|Magallanes and Chilean Antarctica region]] was virtually unchanged at 166,537 people.<ref name=":4" /><ref>{{Cite news |newspaper=El Mercurio |date=2025-03-27 |title=Población censada en Chile llega a los 18,4 millones y Aysén es la única región que disminuye |url=https://www.emol.com/noticias/Nacional/2025/03/27/1161770/censo-primeros-resultados.html |access-date=2026-04-18 |language=es}}</ref> There were five [[Regions of Chile|regions]] with over a million people, those being the Santiago Metropolitan, [[Valparaíso Region|Valparaiso]], [[Biobío Region|Biobio]], [[Maule Region|Maule]] and [[Araucanía Region|Araucania]] regions.<ref name=":4" />
